title: Keyboard Layouts
statementMd:
There are two popular keyboard layouts in Berland, they differ only in letters positions. All the other keys are the same. In Berland they use alphabet with $26$ letters which coincides with English alphabet.

You are given two strings consisting of $26$ distinct letters each: all keys of the first and the second layouts in the same order.

You are also given some text consisting of small and capital English letters and digits. It is known that it was typed in the first layout, but the writer intended to type it in the second layout. Print the text if the same keys were pressed in the second layout.

Since all keys but letters are the same in both layouts, the capitalization of the letters should remain the same, as well as all other characters.

## Input

The first line contains a string of length $26$ consisting of distinct lowercase English letters. This is the first layout.

The second line contains a string of length $26$ consisting of distinct lowercase English letters. This is the second layout.

The third line contains a non-empty string $*s*$ consisting of lowercase and uppercase English letters and digits. This is the text typed in the first layout. The length of $*s*$ does not exceed $1000$.

## Output

Print the text if the same keys were pressed in the second layout.
statementZhMd:
有两种流行的键盘布局，它们仅在字母的位置上有所不同，其他所有按键均相同。在 Berland，他们使用包含 $26$ 个字母、与英文字母表一致的字母表。

给定两个字符串，每个字符串都由 $26$ 个互不相同的字母组成，分别表示第一种和第二种布局中所有按键的顺序。

此外，还给定一段由大小写英文字母和数字组成的文本。已知这段文本是在第一种布局下输入的，但输入者原本想在第二种布局下输入它。请输出如果在第二种布局下按下相同按键时得到的文本。

由于两种布局中除字母外的所有按键都相同，因此字母的大小写应保持不变，其他所有字符也应保持不变。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个长度为 $26$ 的字符串，由互不相同的小写英文字母组成，表示第一种布局。

第二行包含一个长度为 $26$ 的字符串，由互不相同的小写英文字母组成，表示第二种布局。

第三行包含一个非空字符串 *s*，由大小写英文字母和数字组成，表示在第一种布局下输入的文本。*s* 的长度不超过 $1000$。

## 输出格式

输出在第二种布局下按下相同按键时得到的文本。
